run_transformer_training: run transformer sequence model training on character or word-level data with configurable architecture
test_transformer_model: test a transformer model on validation and test datasets without training
build_compressive_transformer: build a compressive transformer model with memory compression for efficient sequence modeling
build_feedback_transformer: build a feedback transformer that computes one step at a time like RNNs
build_staircase_transformer: build a staircase transformer model with adaptive computation per token
